title: Studio Memorandum on the Value of the Work a Specification Change Puts Back on the Bench
content:
# Studio Memorandum on the Value of the Work a Specification Change Puts Back on the Bench

A change to the specification of a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions agreed once the design has been approved is priced first as the value of the work it puts back on the bench, and that value is what the customer commits to when the studio takes their agreement down.

## 1. What the value is made of

The value of the work is the charge for the design revisions the change puts beyond the allowance included in the quoted total, together with the charge for a rendering or a model the programme does not include, together with the charge for handling the centre stone, and the three are added together before anything further is done to the figure.

## 2. The revisions the change puts beyond the allowance

The revisions the change puts beyond the included allowance are counted as the revisions already drawn on the commission plus the one the change calls for, less the revisions the programme includes in the quoted total, and never fewer than none.

Nothing is charged for the revisions the change calls for: the charge for them comes to USD 0.00, whatever the count of revisions beyond the allowance and whatever the programme's published charge for an additional revision.

## 3. A rendering or a model

Nothing is charged for a rendering or a model: that charge comes to USD 0.00.

## 4. Handling the centre stone

Nothing is charged for handling the centre stone: the centre stone is handled at a rate of 0 per cent of what the commission is worth, and 0 per cent of any figure is USD 0.00.

## 5. What the commission is worth

What the commission is worth is read as the quoted total recorded on the commission together with every repricing booked to it.

## 6. The figure

The value reached stands as it is: it is taken at 1, the whole of itself. The figure that results is rounded half up to two decimal places, and the rounding is done once, on that figure alone.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A commission quoted at USD 12000.00 with one repricing of USD 300.00 booked to it, under a programme including 2 design revisions in the quoted total, with 3 revisions already drawn on the commission and a change calling for one more.

| Step | Reading |
|---|---|
| What the commission is worth | USD 12000.00 together with USD 300.00, that is USD 12300.00 |
| Revisions beyond the included allowance | 3 already drawn, plus the 1 the change calls for, less the 2 the programme includes, that is 2 |
| Charge for those revisions | USD 0.00 |
| Charge for a rendering or a model | USD 0.00 |
| Charge for handling the centre stone | 0 per cent of USD 12300.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| The three added together | USD 0.00 |
| The value reached, taken at 1 | USD 0.00 |
| Rounded half up to two decimal places, once | USD 0.00 |

The value of the work the change puts back on the bench is USD 0.00.
